hpx.native.application.admission.validat.title: validate_command • bounded command admission
hpx.native.application.admission.validat.description: Existing validator delegates feature validation and checks bounded text/title/generation/sequence inputs. Serialization/digest happens in storage adapter execute_inner, not the pure domain.

hpx.native.application.replay.records_co.title: Command / Outcome / Receipt / StoredReceipt
hpx.native.application.replay.records_co.description: Actual adapter-owned command/result/receipt data; StoredReceipt binds serialized Command digest to original outcome. This is type evidence, not another receipt store or a new wire/persistence format.

hpx.native.application.dispatch.match_co.title: execute_inner • Command match
hpx.native.application.dispatch.match_co.description: Actual match fragment in the same execute_inner function. Delegates 13 Command variants; returns Outcome/state to caller-owned writer transaction. Branch control is not a new dispatcher function.

hpx.native.storage.coordination_records.title: Cipher • authenticated object and slot operations
hpx.native.storage.coordination_records.description: Existing encrypted record/slot operations on supplied Connection/Transaction. Helpers stage effects; transaction commit belongs to execute_inner. Records/codecs and crypto are adapters outside the dependency-free pure domain.

hpx.native.storage.coordination_document.title: create_document / write_draft / publish_revision
hpx.native.storage.coordination_document.description: Existing original-document creation, mutable Save and single-parent Commit. Commit constructs retained exact one-binding snapshot and event, updates head/draft and promotes matching private checkpoints; Save publishes no immutable revision.

hpx.native.storage.coordination_branches.title: branches • validate / authorize / apply
hpx.native.storage.coordination_branches.description: Existing original/child branch operations; typed document/branch authority checked before receipt replay, mutable generations checked only for a new operation. Not general composition or two-parent publication.

hpx.native.storage.coordination_working_.title: working_forks • validate / apply
hpx.native.storage.coordination_working_.description: Existing fork from an exact private working checkpoint; independent new identity/provenance, not same-node ancestry or an implicit source Commit.

hpx.native.storage.coordination_private_.title: clipboard / working_clipboard • capture and mutations
hpx.native.storage.coordination_private_.description: Existing private committed and working reference mutations; WorkingCopy atomically stages checkpoint plus private reference. Reference capture/clipboard publication is not immutable text Commit.

c4_application_transaction.description: Primary parent: Command admission and transaction scope. Shared contributors: Original operation and receipt reconciliation; Atomic outcome and receipt publication. Workspace execute/execute_inner/receipt share existing code; no application crate/dispatcher service is introduced. Input: decoded Command/operation plus trusted workspace identity. Output: receipt/error, not delivery acknowledgement. Solid calls/control; dotted type/data/returns.

Shared contributors: documents/branches, derivation/contributors, private references, assertions and comments from the C3 context. Output: Outcome/error to execute_inner; helper effects stay staged until receipt COMMIT. Pure planners do not authorize or publish. Independent Synthesis is not parent Merge.

c4_application_reads.title: C4 / Protected read entry points — Implementation
c4_application_reads.description: Parent: Protected read entry points. Runtime directly calls existing Workspace query families; API contracts retain exact methods/payloads. No execute path/common read facade is invented. Inputs: current unlocked identity and exact IDs/cursors/budgets. Outputs: method-specific authenticated results/errors; history example is explicit. Receipts query the original result but recheck current outcome scope. Method-local transactions/limits differ; authority context edge is not one shared call. Queries do not grant mutation or historical key rights.
